subject: Post-call: Dedicated GPU isolation & scaling — recap and proposed SLAs
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Emily Santos <emily.santos@orthogenix.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@orthogenix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Dedicated GPU isolation & scaling — recap and proposed SLAs

Hi Emily / Rajiv — thanks again for the time today. Quick synthesized recap from our discovery so we have alignment and clear next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of the call (pain points + goals)
- Production inference instability during high-concurrency clinical-read bursts (prediction latency spikes during batch windows).
- Strict data isolation requirement for patient PII and model inputs — must be single-tenant/pool-level isolation behind their VPC.
- Predictable unit economics: they need a reservation model (committed capacity) for budget planning; low variance in per-token costs.
- Target throughput and latency goals: steady-state inference for 10k requests/day, peak concurrency ~200 rps; target p95 latency <120ms, p99 <250ms for the primary model.
- Timeline: procurement window in August, pilot in September/early October.

Proposed Redwood dedicated configuration (high-level)
- Reserved single-tenant pool: 8x H100-equivalent GPUs (can be mapped to 16x A100 depending on SKUs) with NVLink across nodes for large KV-cache sharing.
- Isolation: dedicated VPC + optional dedicated control plane for auditability; KMS integration for keys.
- Scaling: autoscaling policy to maintain latency SLOs with burst capacity into Redwood shared fleet when utilization >85% (policy is configurable).
- SLO targets we recommend: 99.9% availability SLA; p95 latency <120ms; p99 latency budget <250ms (with a documented fallback to a slightly smaller model if latency thresholds would otherwise breach).

Commercial/operational notes
- Preliminary capacity estimate attached (orthogenix-capacity-estimate.xlsx) and a draft SLA/term outline (RDW_Dedicated_SLA_Proposal_Orthogenix_v1.pdf). These are starting points; we can tune pool size and pricing after the tech deep-dive.
- Procurement asks: procurement contact, PO cadence (monthly vs annual), and security questionnaire owner for the SOC 2 evidence exchange.

Next steps (owners & tentative dates)
- Redwood: deliver two firm options (Gold: fully single-tenant 8x H100 equiv; Silver: reserved slices + stricter tenancy controls) — owner: Marissa — by 2026-07-20 EOD.
- Orthogenix: confirm procurement contact + target budget window — owner: Dr. Emily / Rajiv — by 2026-07-23.
- Technical deep-dive (networking and model KV cache) — schedule for week of 2026-07-22; owner: Karthik to run.
- Security/Compliance: we will drop SOC 2 artifacts and a short evidence checklist into the shared Drive link after you confirm the security owner — owner: Jordan.

Attachments: RDW_Dedicated_SLA_Proposal_Orthogenix_v1.pdf, orthogenix-capacity-estimate.xlsx

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick follow if helpful.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0126

From: Dr. Emily Santos <emily.santos@orthogenix.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@orthogenix.com>, Procurement <procurement@orthogenix.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T17:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Dedicated GPU isolation & scaling — recap and proposed SLAs

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. A couple of clarifications and asks from our side: 

1) Procurement cadence: we are likely to push for an annual committed contract but need a line item for a 3-month pilot under the same legal vehicle to validate before full commit.
2) Budget: the CFO is expecting a mid-six-figure figure for the year; please avoid proposals that look like open-ended consumption for now.
3) Security: we will need SOC 2 Type II report and an architecture diagram showing where PII stops (we cannot have model artefacts land in shared storage).
4) Latency: p99 <200ms would be ideal for our production SLAs — I know you recommended <250ms; if you can propose a technical mitigation (e.g., model sharding + KV cache placement) that achieves tighter p99 we would prioritize that.

Also copying procurement — the person who will own contracts is Priya Ramaswami (procurement@orthogenix.com). She will send us PO template/terms.

—Emily
Director of ML Systems | Orthogenix

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Emily Santos <emily.santos@orthogenix.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@orthogenix.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Dedicated GPU isolation & scaling — recap and proposed SLAs

Emily — great notes. I will produce two clean options this afternoon that map to the budget envelope you outlined. Preliminary thoughts: 

- Gold (recommended for strict SLAs): true single-tenant pool (dedicated nodes, reserved NVLink) sized for headroom to keep p99 below 200ms for current model. Includes 24/7 priority capacity reservations, monthly usage report, and a 99.9% uptime SLA.
- Silver (cost-optimized): reserved capacity with stronger tenancy controls (no co-tenanted inference on the same NICs), smaller pool, autoscale into shared fleet for short bursts. SLOs: p95 <120ms, p99 <250ms; price materially lower but slightly higher tail latency under sustained bursts.

Action items I will take:
- Share the two-option proposal + line-item pricing (deliverable: updated PDF + a one-pager for your CFO) by 2026-07-20 COB.
- Book the technical deep-dive (30–45 min) with Karthik and your infra lead — propose 2026-07-23 10:00 AM PT; please confirm.
- Drop the SOC 2 checklist and the architecture guidance doc into the shared drive link once procurement confirms Priya as the security owner.

If you want to push for p99 <200ms we can outline the infrastructure and model mitigations (sharded KV cache co-located with model kernels, reserve additional headroom) in the tech deep-dive.

Thanks — Marissa
Senior Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

- Marissa will send Gold vs Silver options + CFO one-pager today (owner: Marissa).
- Karthik to run the technical deep-dive on 2026-07-23 10:00 AM PT (owner: Karthik).
- Priya (Procurement) to share PO template and any contract constraints by 2026-07-23 (owner: Priya).

We will also include a short appendix in the proposal that maps the engineering mitigations to expected p99 improvement so you have a clear trade-off table. If anything shifts on timing, please ping me and we’ll adapt.
